CustomField.description: Comma-separated first names treated as the same person, e.g. "Robert, Bob, Rob, Bobby". Case does not matter. A name may appear in more than one group (Chris is in both Christopher and Christine). Author: Jason Ott.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Comma-separated first names that mean the same person, e.g. Robert, Bob, Rob, Bobby.
CustomField.label: Names
